references.summary: Tuber crop; harvest product can be early new potatoes or mature storage tubers. Frost can kill foliage even where protected underground organs survive. High soil temperature can impair tuber initiation and growth; soil and air heat measurements are not interchangeable. Solanaceous crops can share pathogens; breaks must account for volunteers and the particular nematode or disease. Tuber initiation, canopy growth and bulking have different water and temperature sensitivities; seed-tuber health matters.
